headline: EPS surges both sequentially and year-over-year
summary_short: Sanrin reported Q2 FY2026 EPS of ¥47.99, up 79.5% q/q and up 737.5% y/y.
summary_long: EPS of ¥47.99 rose 79.5% sequentially from ¥26.74 and surged 737.5% year-over-year from ¥5.73. This is the only KPI carried on the shard for this period; no revenue, margin, or balance-sheet figures are available from the wire feed.
confidence_notes: primary filing unreachable — KPI-only summary from verified shard data.
